overview: The United Kingdom is an island country off the north-west coast of Europe, made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Its capital and largest city is London. The UK is a constitutional monarchy. In the 1800s and early 1900s Britain ruled the largest empire in history. It left the European Union in 2020, and it is one of the five permanent members of the UN Security Council.

geography.text: The UK covers the island of Great Britain, the north-east of the island of Ireland and many smaller islands. The north and west, including the Scottish Highlands and much of Wales, are hilly or mountainous, and Ben Nevis in Scotland is the highest peak. The south and east of England are lower and gentler. The UK is surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean, the North Sea, the English Channel and the Irish Sea.
